en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, 
(It has been narrated) from Jameel Bin Darraj regarding the wergild, he<sup>asws</sup> (6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) said: ‘

A thousand Dinar, or ten thousand Dirhams, and the garments would be seized from the owner of the garments, and the camels would be seized from the owners of the camels, and the sheep from the owners of the sheep, and the cows from the owners of the cows’.
